overview:
USA universities have winter courses during the winter break that international students can take to learn new skills, explore academic interests, earn university credits and experience American campus life.

Such programs can be short academic courses, English language training, business and technology programs, professional certificates and university winter sessions. Students can choose between online, hybrid or in-person learning, depending on the school.

faq.question: What are winter courses in the US?
faq.answer: Winter courses are short-term academic or professional programs, usually offered from December to January during the winter break. Some institutions also offer winter programs that run into February.

faq.question: Can Indian students apply for winter courses in USA?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students can apply for the programs that allow international or visiting students and meet the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: How long are the winter courses?
faq.answer: Winter sessions usually run for about three to four weeks, but some programs are shorter or longer.

faq.question: Are there winter courses online?
faq.answer: Yes. Several universities offer fully online winter sessions, while some programs provide in-person or hybrid learning. Some courses offer academic credit. Before you register, see if your current university will give you credit for those credits toward your current degree.
